{
  "decision-fit-transfer-evidence-on-a-display-card": "SELECT a.slip_id AS first_slip, b.slip_id AS second_slip, a.points + b.points AS detail_points, a.chars + b.chars AS print_chars
FROM transfer_slip AS a
JOIN transfer_slip AS b ON a.slip_id COLLATE BINARY < b.slip_id
WHERE a.chars + b.chars <= 100
  AND (a.capture_flag = 1 OR b.capture_flag = 1)
  AND (a.copy_flag = 1 OR b.copy_flag = 1)
  AND (a.master_flag = 1 OR b.master_flag = 1)
ORDER BY detail_points DESC, print_chars ASC, first_slip COLLATE BINARY ASC, second_slip COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-flag-impossible-gallery-transfers": "WITH adjacent AS (
  SELECT object_code, visit_no, note_id AS to_note, gallery_code AS dest_code, late_day,
         LAG(note_id) OVER itinerary AS from_note,
         LAG(gallery_code) OVER itinerary AS origin_code,
         LAG(early_day) OVER itinerary AS origin_early_day
  FROM gallery_note
  WINDOW itinerary AS (PARTITION BY object_code ORDER BY visit_no)
)
SELECT a.object_code, a.from_note, a.to_note,
       m.min_days - (a.late_day - a.origin_early_day) AS shortfall_days
FROM adjacent AS a
JOIN transfer_minimum AS m ON m.origin_code = a.origin_code AND m.dest_code = a.dest_code
WHERE a.origin_code <> a.dest_code
  AND a.late_day - a.origin_early_day < m.min_days
ORDER BY a.object_code COLLATE BINARY ASC, a.visit_no ASC",
  "decision-four-day-closing-balance-interest": "WITH days(day_no) AS (VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4)),
closing_balances AS (
  SELECT o.account_code, o.opening_cents + COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(m.delta_cents)
    FROM deposit_movements AS m
    WHERE m.account_code = o.account_code AND m.posting_day BETWEEN 1 AND d.day_no
  ), 0) AS closing_cents
  FROM deposit_openings AS o CROSS JOIN days AS d
),
totals AS (
  SELECT account_code, SUM(closing_cents) AS balance_day_cents
  FROM closing_balances
  GROUP BY account_code
)
SELECT account_code, balance_day_cents,
       (balance_day_cents / 10000) * 3 + ((balance_day_cents % 10000) * 3 + 5000) / 10000 AS interest_cents
FROM totals
ORDER BY account_code ASC",
  "decision-frozen-archive-location-manifest": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT segment_id, shelf_code, event_no,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_id ORDER BY minute_no DESC, event_no DESC) AS event_rank
  FROM catalog_event
  WHERE minute_no <= 30
)
SELECT segment_id, shelf_code, event_no AS placement_event
FROM ranked
WHERE event_rank = 1 AND shelf_code IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY shelf_code COLLATE BINARY ASC, segment_id COLLATE BINARY ASC"
}
